tasks.name: PatchPad 1.1
tasks.headline: Oracle passed 20/20 after rubric independence, harness hardening, and focused golden browser/API checks.

blocks.title: Verifier calibration
items: Twenty binary criteria cover twenty feature/sub-feature slices with weights from 0.5 to 1.5.
Tough criteria require exact full markers and exact resulting text; one-character proxies and alternate interaction paths are forbidden.
Cross-feature dependency chains were removed so each failure reflects its own behavior instead of cascading from another criterion.

blocks.title: Golden checks completed
items: Exact 1,226-line seed generation, padded line identifiers, and tail sentinel.
Real mouse word/line/range selection, offscreen selection, and external multiline clipboard behavior.
Grouped undo/redo, complete multi-caret edits, exact find/replace counts, long-document round trip, revision restore, stale conflicts, and malformed-save non-mutation.

blocks.title: Solvability proof
items: Harbor Oracle job patchpad-oracle-v1-1-01 passed all 20 browser criteria with reward 1.0.
